## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what changes for the user or operator.

## Validation

- List the checks actually run and their results.
- Identify checks still pending and any material limitations.

## Dependencies and deployment

- Link prerequisite PRs if this change is stacked.
- For runtime changes, identify the exact tested revision and any deployed revision.
- Describe relevant state, journal, configuration or rollback considerations.
- Distinguish simulation evidence from funded execution and economic claims.

## Review

- [ ] The diff targets the intended current base and contains no credentials or private runtime artifacts.
- [ ] Another contributor has reviewed code changes before merge.
- [ ] Applicable CI checks pass; any missing validation is stated explicitly.
